newsitem.title: USA: Hurricane expected to veer north of Caribbean.
newsitem.headline: Hurricane expected to veer north of Caribbean.

text.p: Hurricane Edouard grew stronger on Saturday as it swirled across the Atlantic Ocean, but forecasters at the National Hurricane Center said the storm would likely swing north and miss the Caribbean.
"Edouard is getting stronger and stronger, and it already has winds of 105 mph (185 kph)," said hurricane forecaster Lixion Avila.
"But the good news is that all our computer models indicate Edouard is going to turn to the west-northwest on Sunday and miss the islands," he added.
At 11 a.m. EDT (1500 GMT), Edouard was 1,130 miles east of the Lesser Antilles and moving west at 14 mph (25 kph). Its exact position was latitude 14.5 north, longitude 44.2 west.
